notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[b]Important:[/b] This game is expected to become [u]free to play[/u] soon. 

The update contains a brand new menu, a language selector, and some small tweaks.
Thank you for your support.

Free the pigeons!

notes.title: Have you seen this bird?
notes.notes:
[b]Born Tubi Wild is finally coming to Steam![/b]
We created this sweet little game based on a wacky idea a few years ago, just for fun and testing the limits of the rm2k3 game engine. This is our international debut as well, after some fairly popular adventure games in Hungary. We're proud to bring these lovely pigeons to you and your city, now everything's gonna be covered with sh♥♥!

Trading cards coming soon!

Cheers,
Team Dzsembori
